purpose: Distinguish actual tipster directional information from market-favourite calibration and source sampling effects.
control: Replace each expert direction by the same fixture market argmax while retaining source, author, timestamps, prices, split and exact-document grouping; fit the primary selected architecture with its frozen hyperparameters and compare predictions on the same test fixtures.
selection: Never use this diagnostic to choose an architecture, tune a coefficient or change the primary split; report separately after primary fixed selection.
interpretation: Similar or better sham-expert performance cannot support a claim that human directional information produced the gain. A difference alone is still not causal proof or executable profit evidence.
disclosure: Exploratory reused dataset; addendum frozen before receiving the new candidate's performance results. Not an independent blind test.
